issuer.summary: Sky/Maker has a long operating history and public, reviewable governance and delegation, providing greater operating accountability than an opaque single operator. Retain Issuer 7.0 provisionally: protocol operating continuity is distinct from unresolved token-specific corporate payout, current reserve title/beneficiary/enforcement and insolvency/shutdown rights. Skybase is an interface counterparty and Sky Frontier Foundation disclaims issuing/redemption/custody/guarantees; neither is substituted as repayment obligor. Complete registrations/controllers, signed protocol-wide assurance and comprehensive conduct history remain unestablished. Governance discretion and allocator/vehicle complexity constrain the assessment. No score credit here for code audits, bounty size, universal 48h control or fresh security verification.
issuer.summary_source: September 1 Skybase terms; January 28 SFF publication terms; official token docs/README and Foundation Q3 report, checked November 4. Documentary scope only; old financial/security clocks are not renewed.
facts: Skybase International operates the interface; Sky Frontier Foundation disclaims issuing, redemption, custody, reserve management and guarantees. These roles do not establish a corporate token payout undertaking.
Protocol conversion and PSM exchange differ from a universal corporate fiat redemption claim; current reserve-vehicle title, beneficiary/enforcement and insolvency rights remain unresolved.
No signed protocol-wide reserve/solvency assurance was established; Foundation analysis, dashboards, code audits and credit ratings have separate scopes. Vehicle-specific audits may exist.

Original portal reports October 12/29 execution stages; imported November 7/20 vote rows use spell expiries and are excluded pending producer repair. No independent execution receipt verification performed.
Q3 Foundation report discloses a July legacy RWA write-off; no comprehensive incident-free/economic-loss-free claim is supported.
